_doc: This bot's Lead Radar settings: the AI Guy Lead Radar plus job sites. No key or token here.
offer: help with AI, automation or a virtual assistant; and, for a company that is hiring for that work, Justin as a fractional staff member: he brings AI automation and lands partnerships, collaborations, sponsorships, speaking engagements and podcasts, leads the company does not pay for
buyer: business owners and operators asking for AI or VA help, and companies hiring a virtual assistant or an AI role
leave_outs: staffing agencies and recruiters posting for someone else
how-to questions with no need behind them

routes._doc: The four routes. The data route is named here and not built yet.

sources._doc: Which sources are on. With account owner, Treg is reached inside One API. With account client, one-api is off.

one-api.trial: the name of the trial the owner funded for this business

dashboard-radar.note: the AI Guy Lead Radar: its campaigns of people asking for AI or VA help, and its job-board campaigns. The worker's radar-poll job reads it

lead-radar-agent.note: the standalone Lead Radar agent, where the business runs one; its leads go to the sales agent like any other source

metamuse.note: reads Facebook and Instagram through the owner's own Meta account, where the business has it set up

channels._doc: via: account means the source the account setting gives (One API for the owner, Treg for a client). read holds the tool ids found in the catalog for that channel. terms are the phrases people use when they ask.

places: private groups, by link: read through a signed-in browser
the Skool groups joined, by link: posts and comments
skool.note: read through a signed-in browser; Treg carries no read for it

places: the Whop groups joined, by link: posts and comments
whop.note: read through a signed-in browser; Treg carries no read for it

hand_off.hiring: requests/cold-email/ as a row for the fractional campaign, with the post's link and the first line; the Dream lists when the company is one Justin would most want
hand_off.crm: every kept lead, at once, through the conversation log
hand_off.partners: each possible influencer or partner found in a group, added to the list and pointed to in requests/partners/

job_sites._doc: People looking to hire VAs and AI roles (Justin, 2026-11-20: 'AI Guy Lead Radar plus all the job sites'). Read as public pages by the data lane's scrapers, cheapest rung first, or through Treg's job-posting reads inside One API. The site list is a starting list from this build, not his: he adds or removes freely. LinkedIn Jobs is read only through OutFlo or his own computer.
